questions.question: Which Azure feature automatically increases and decreases the number of identical VMs based on demand?

options.why: They spread VMs, they do not scale.

questions.question: An availability set protects VMs by placing them in different what?

options.why: Availability sets are within one datacenter.

questions.explanation: Fault domains separate hardware; update domains separate maintenance.

questions.question: What is the additional cost of using an availability set?

options.text: No additional cost; you pay only for the VMs
A fixed monthly fee per set
